correctness.rationale: Reduced closed walks of odd length m=g+2 are either injective m-cycles or g-cycles with one immediate backtrack; two disjoint backtracks would force cycle length <=g−2, violating girth. Square-freeness (at most one common neighbor for distinct vertices) makes each nontrivial cell a simplex with one variable coordinate, and injective m-cycles are isolated. Outside branches attach as free simplices and collapse onto a winding component of Hom(C_{g+2},C_g), a cycle of exactly gm homomorphisms per orientation. Thus 2*c_g S1 components and 2m*c_m singleton components; no higher homology. Independently enumerated complete homomorphism adjacency for C5, C7 (two values of g), 5-/7-cycle wedge and bridge, with predicted circle/isolated counts; finite samples confirm, not prove all H.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate exact identities only; all-parameter assertions depend on the reconstructed proof and named published premises.

originality.rationale: The classical Hom(C_m,C_g) cycle homotopy and square-free codomain point-or-circle theorems are already known, but the quantitative global formula in two consecutive cycle counts and explicit free collapse for arbitrary girth-g target are the assessed refinements. The highly relevant Fujii/Kimura/Nozaki and Matsushita PDFs were accessed and their theorems reviewed; priority still carries a risk from generic component algorithms.
residual_risks: A general algorithm of Fujii–Kimura–Nozaki might yield the explicit cycle counts as an immediate specialization even though its main theorems do not state them; no claim that algorithms are not applicable.

value.rationale: A single natural graph-Hom functor extracts the two shortest relevant odd cycle counts as Betti and component statistics, with an explicit canonical collapse. The all-graph-girth theorem is structural and offers a useful graph-homotopy/cycle-count correspondence beyond the already known point/circle dichotomy.
residual_risks: No result for source lengths beyond g+2 where multiple reversals arise.

limitations: Simple undirected loopless graph target and odd girth threshold g>=5.
Source fixed to m=g+2; no general larger source lengths.
Each circle collapse is homotopy, not a literal equality of spaces.
